items.t: Why Is Lam Research (LRCX) Down 11.5% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.sum: Lam Research (LRCX) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.t: Lam Research sees wafer-fab spending topping $200 billion in 2027 on AI demand
items.sum: Doug Bettinger, EVP & Chief Financial Officer at Lam Research, expects wafer-fab equipment spending to surge next year as AI demand outpaces the industry’s capacity to supply. He also weighs in on the latest developments at Nvidia and how they affect overall business sentiment.

items.t: Lam Research Corp (NASDAQ:LRCX): Dividend Quality for Income Investors
items.sum: Lam Research passes a dividend screen with strong profitability, low payout ratio, and 14.8% dividend growth, though cyclical risks remain.

items.t: Billionaires Split on Lam Research. Is the Stock a Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.sum: David Tepper loaded up on Lam Research while Stanley Druckenmiller dumped every share, just as the stock slid hard from its highs. One of these billionaires is reading the chip-equipment cycle wrong, and the evidence points in a surprising direction.
